Nice to meet you over email. I’m Vanessa on the vendor ops team at Redwood Inference. We’re kicking off the procurement onboarding for HeliumTech (PO-7841). To get the vendor record created and enable PO/ACH routing, can you please send the following by end of day Wednesday (7/8)?

Required (please attach where possible):
- Completed buyer intake form (I attached an editable copy)
- Legal entity name and full remit-to address
- W9 (or equivalent tax form)
- Bank letter or voided check showing account name + routing and account number (for ACH)
- Preferred payment method (ACH or wire) and remittance email for PO invoices

Optional but helpful:
- Billing contact and AP email
- Invoicing cadence (net30, PO-required, etc.)

Next steps on our side after we receive the docs:
- Karthik (cc’d) will create the vendor entity in our system and route to Finance for verification.
- We’ll return a vendor ID and confirm PO routing and payment terms.
- I’ll also send a DocuSign link for our standard vendor agreement if we don’t already have one on file.

Attachments: buyer_intake_form.xlsx (fillable)

If you have any questions about the fields, reply here and Karthik and I will help. Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround so we can get first PO processed.

Best,

- Rolling monthly payments: We can accommodate monthly aggregated invoices for usage-based charges; for PO-driven purchases we’ll follow the PO and invoice terms (net 30). If you’d like to pursue a consolidated monthly statement for usage, I can loop in Billing to propose an approach.

- Please sign the vendor agreement — I sent a DocuSign link (https://docusign.com/recipient/abcdef1234567890).
